correctness.rationale: The helper implements the full documented exit/result contract with centralized _emit paths for CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, SHA_CHANGED, TIMEOUT, and API_ERROR, head SHA checks before and after each snapshot, env defaults (INTERVAL/QUIET_WINDOW/MAX_WAIT), in-memory-only state, and allow-list normalization. Bats cases exercise each terminal result and matching exit code end-to-end via a stubbed gh seam. One minor inspectable gap: reviews(first:100) and reviewThreads(first:100) can truncate state on very active PRs, which is not addressed in the contract or tests.

quality.rationale: Implementation is well-structured (validation, allow-list load, GitHub seam functions, pure jq _poll_evaluate, poll loop), matches repo shell conventions (set -uo pipefail, stderr diagnostics, testable gh seams), and includes thorough header documentation. Docs are synced in pr-resolve-all.md (helper preference plus documented time-based fallback preserved) and AI_REPO_GUIDE.md. Bats harness is clean with a reusable fake gh fixture. Minor deduction for embedding a large inline GraphQL document in the shell script, which is maintainable but heavier than extracting a jq filter file as some sibling scripts do.

process.rationale: Diff is tightly scoped to the seven requested surfaces (helper, allow-list, prompt, guide, check wiring, smoke check, bats). Companion docs and checks are updated per repo doc-maintenance patterns (105-scripts.sh inventory, new 141 smoke check). No forbidden paths, scope noise, or unrelated churn evident in files-changed.txt.

reliability.rationale: Ten Bats cases meaningfully cover CONVERGED (including bot normalization), QUIET_ELAPSED when convergence is blocked, SHA_CHANGED, TIMEOUT, multiple API_ERROR paths, and non-allow-listed bot exclusion; smoke check wires them into test.sh. Objective evidence confirms bash -n and lint-shell-conventions pass. Bats and full test.sh were skipped in objective grading (no executed run artifact in bundle), and tests do not cover multi-iteration polling (sleep loop retries) or gh pr view failure—coverage gaps, not fabrication.

citations.claim: _emit prints RESULT= and HEAD= on success paths; _die_api_error emits RESULT=API_ERROR with exit 4
Poll loop reads head SHA before and after snapshot and exits 3 with RESULT=SHA_CHANGED when sha_before != sha_after or snap_head != sha_before

CONVERGED exits 0 when jq terminal is true (participating > 0 and unresolved == 0); QUIET_ELAPSED exits 0 when quiet window elapsed since latest_event or START_EPOCH; TIMEOUT exits 2 when MAX_WAIT exceeded
INTERVAL defaults 20, QUIET_WINDOW 360, MAX_WAIT 900; BOT_ALLOWLIST defaults to scripts/lib/bot-allowlist.txt
GraphQL query uses reviews(last:100) and reviewThreads(first:100), imposing pagination limits
